name: Montreal
industries: Aerospace manufacturing, AI research labs, game studios and banking operations define Montreal's dual-natured market.
intro:
Montreal runs Canada's aerospace and AI economies side by side: Bombardier, CAE and the supplier network make it one of the world's three aerospace capitals, while Mila's research gravity has drawn every major AI lab to the city. Add the game studios, banks' Quebec operations and infrastructure renewal, and delivery roles span both formal program management and deeply agile software work. Bilingual professionals with international certification are especially mobile here. We run live online cohorts throughout the year on Montreal-friendly hours — weekend Saturday–Sunday batches and midweek Wednesday–Thursday batches both — meaning learners in Montreal attend at ordinary local times, never overnight; the table below shows each upcoming date converted for Montreal. Unchanged throughout: live weekend instruction, exam application support, calibrated mock exams, and trainer access until you clear.

Montreal delivers projects in two languages and three signature industries: aerospace primes and their supplier network, a gaming and visual-effects cluster with studio-scale pipelines, and the AI research economy commercializing around Mile End. International certification carries weight precisely because Montreal's programs plug into global supply chains. Training is live online across two consecutive days shown in Montreal local time on this page, delivered in English. Quebec compensation structures differ from Ontario's; the sourced Montreal entries below give this market's own dated figures for certified roles. The employer list shows the aerospace-gaming-AI mix hiring certified project talent, and primes can certify supplier-facing program staff together through private cohorts.
